reason: An interface plugin that provides an archived-session panel for listing, previewing, and restoring DeepSeek Harness sessions, with optional archive confirmation and local settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供归档会话回收站面板，用于查看、预览和恢复会话，并可选启用归档确认。
summaries.en: Provides an archived-session recycle-bin panel for DeepSeek Harness to list, preview, and restore sessions with optional archive confirmation.

capabilities: Lists archived sessions grouped by workspace
Previews limited archived session text and metadata
Restores individual or all archived sessions to their original workspace
Wraps the archive action with an optional confirmation dialog
Persists plugin settings in a local file
